review_questions: Do the frozen author blob, observed hashes and official SuiteSparse metadata identify the same Landmark matrix?
Does the official source support the stated CC-BY-4.0 and attribution/modification obligations?
Does the script stream rather than densify, validate the complete source, and avoid scientific scoring?
Are the first-5000-row counts descriptive source qualification rather than an invented benchmark or result?
Is the one-core, 512-MiB, 60-second, one-attempt envelope safe and bounded?
